prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a vertical three-quarter fine-art portrait of an adult woman standing in a windy, indistinct outdoor landscape. She faces right in serene profile, with a loose low bun and windblown strands, wearing a textured ribbed V-neck wrap dress with a cinched waist and three-quarter sleeves. Render the scene as a wet-plate-inspired sepia photograph with soft overcast light, aged plate texture, restrained scratches and dust, mild edge wear, fine grain, and a subtle horizontal motion-smear band. Keep the mood quiet, ghostly, and contemplative, with realistic anatomy and fabric texture. No text, logo, watermark, or sexualized styling.
